rootCauseHypothesis.evidence: Attempt16's lifecycle candidate captured only frame216, failed to expose the runtime selector, and ended with a launch at x=332.7 rather than a second stored pose. Attempt11 independently proves that the desired behavior has two distinct keyed runway edges at frames216 and302; the candidate did not record enough edge state to distinguish suppression from ordinary-anchor fall-through.
rootCauseHypothesis.changeHypothesis: Implement the pending pose setter and runtime selector with a per-edge latch keyed by supportId, sharp contact part, and top-face class. A live keyed manifold cannot overwrite; only an observed no-hit transition can rearm that key. A qualifying separating top contact remains airborne and stores the immutable support-relative pose, while side/body/approaching contacts keep their existing branches.

rootCauseHypothesis.selectorRule: runtime release selector returns the same reachable authored support selected by the recorded candidate trace, including white-branch and late lift-plank fixtures

acceptanceCriteria: Run and save RED focused evidence before edits.
Record per-edge contact enter/leave, pose set, consume, expire, clear, rearm, and ordinary-anchor events with support, part, top class, frame, recoveryAge, status, and collision context.
Expose a runtime selector whose early and late fixture results match the recorded white-branch and lift-plank candidates.
Capture exactly frames216 and302 with the retained pose coordinates and no same-manifold overwrite.
Keep both pending intervals airborne with measurable 12–13px-scale motion and normal rotation.
Consume each saved pose once at the scheduled taps and emit the standard launch from the stored support-relative pose.
A separating runway top contact never falls through to an ordinary anchor while the keyed edge is active.
Rearm a keyed edge only after an observed no-hit transition; side/body contacts do not rearm the sharp-top key.
Preserve exact 2.35-second TTL and clear on reset/load/terminal/inactive/non-runway branches.
Keep tap corrections within retained focused bounds without adding a new per-frame follow gain.
Trace frame528's clear reason if the replay reaches it; do not assume TTL, collision, terminal, or inactivity without evidence.
Preserve approaching, side/body, x>=350, non-runway, opening, later-route, and ordinary anchored release behavior.
Reach at least 11.9 seconds and player x>2000 in the fixed replay without failure.
Run focused tests and pnpm test only after focused GREEN passes.
Run pnpm lint and pnpm typecheck only after focused GREEN passes, then exactly one pnpm build with dist hash.
Rollback both owned files immediately on focused failure and make no natural/perceptual completion claim.
